summary: Frontend-only regression of the Global Currency Selector. Tested every user story from the review request via Playwright against the public EXPO_BACKEND_URL as ryan@ryan.com (token seeded to localStorage due to preview auth quirk). ONE CRITICAL BUG was found and fixed at /app/frontend/app/settings/currency.tsx line 174 — the module-level `useStyles = () => themedStyles((c) => ({...}))()` had an extra `()` at the end, calling the returned Proxy as if it were a factory. Every attempt to open /settings/currency crashed with `TypeError: (0 , _srcThemeContext.themedStyles)(...) is not a function` and the whole screen went red. Removing the trailing `()` (to match every other file in the codebase that uses `themedStyles((c) => ({...}))` directly) fixes the crash. AFTER THE FIX all six review-request items pass end-to-end: (1) More tab -> 'Currency' row is present with subtitle 'Choose the currency used across the app' (testID more-currency); tap navigates to /settings/currency. (2) Picker renders MOST COMMON section with USD pinned first followed by EUR/GBP/CAD/AUD/JPY, then ALL CURRENCIES (A-Z) section, all rows carry testID currency-<CODE>; header buttons testID currency-back + currency-search input work. (3) Search 'euro' filters COMMON down to Euro only (USD row disappears); search by code 'EUR' also matches. (4) Selecting EUR persists to AsyncStorage key `tbv_currency_code::<userId>=EUR` and closes the picker. (5) After EUR, Home dashboard shows €150.00 / €1,285.50 / €640.00 (7 €-symbol occurrences, ZERO residual '$' money on Home/Inventory/Reports/Dealer/Tool detail). Inventory rows: €72/€267/€75/€249/€899. Dealer detail: €1,399.00. Tool detail: €0.00. (6) Switching to JPY renders ¥150 / ¥1,286 / ¥640 with NO decimals — confirmed via regex — matching decimals:0 config. Switching to INR renders ₹150.00 / ₹1,285.50 with 2 decimals. (7) Reverting to USD restores exact original amounts $150.00 / $1,285.50 / $640.00 on Home; no €/¥/₹ remain. No red-screen errors on any tested screen (Home, Inventory, Reports, Dealers list, Dealer detail, Tool detail) after currency changes. Final state: USD restored so other tests start clean. Note on Playwright: TouchableOpacity onPress in the web preview requires `locator.evaluate('el => el.click()')`; `page.click(force=True)` on force-clicked rows silently no-ops (documented in iter83). This is a testing quirk only; native taps work fine.
action_items: None — critical themedStyles crash fixed inline. Feature is fully working. Optional: consider explicitly declaring `<Stack.Screen name="settings/currency" />` in /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx alongside other named routes for parity (expo-router auto-discovers it today, so this is purely cosmetic).

Optional: the picker file imports `SafeAreaView` from `react-native-safe-area-context` — fine. But adding `edges=['top','bottom']` (currently only 'top') could avoid the FlatList's last row being obscured on notch devices; verify on iPhone-X-class hardware.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG (fixed): /app/frontend/app/settings/currency.tsx line 174 called `themedStyles(...)()` — themedStyles returns a Proxy directly, not a factory. Every other file in the codebase uses `const styles = themedStyles((c) => ({...}))` without a trailing invocation. Left over from the currency sweep; would crash the entire Currency screen on open.

currency.ts uses a module-level `current` variable + a Set of listeners for reactivity — clean pattern. `useCurrency()` correctly subscribes/unsubscribes. Persistence is namespaced per userId (tbv_currency_code::<uid>) which is correct so multiple accounts on the same device do not stomp each other.
formatMoney() honours per-currency decimals (JPY/KRW/CLP => 0, BHD/JOD/KWD/OMR/TND/LYD => 3, default 2) and uses toLocaleString('en-US') for grouping — deterministic across locales.
No hardcoded '$' remain in the seven audited money sites (index, inventory, dealer/[id], dealers, wishlist, for-sale, tool/[id], claim/[id], bundle/index) — all use formatMoney().

Auth pipeline calls initCurrency() twice on cold start (once in the eager bootstrap, once inside writeCachedUser on login) — redundant but harmless (2nd call is a no-op if the code is already applied).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (7/7 user stories pass after 1 critical fix)

seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Currency preference set to EUR/JPY/INR during test; reverted to USD at end so downstream tests see defaults.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview auth: log in via API (POST /api/auth/login {email, password}), then set localStorage['tt.auth.token'] and localStorage['tt.auth.user'] = JSON.stringify(user) BEFORE reload. Web preview TouchableOpacity: page.click(force=True) sometimes silently no-ops on RN-web; always use `page.locator(sel).evaluate('el => el.click()')` for row/button taps. What's-New modal blocks Home on first login — dismiss with `page.get_by_text('GOT IT').click(force=True)`. Currency system testIDs: more-currency (row on More screen), currency-back (header back), currency-search (search TextInput), currency-<CODE> per row (currency-USD/EUR/JPY/INR/...). Persistence key in localStorage: `tbv_currency_code::<userId>`. formatMoney respects per-currency decimals: JPY/KRW/PYG/VND/etc. render 0 decimals, BHD/JOD/KWD/LYD/OMR/TND render 3, everything else 2. When switching currencies, reload the target screen (goto) — the reactive hook does update in place, but a fresh nav is the safest way to snapshot text.
rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE: /app/frontend/app/settings/currency.tsx line 174 defined `const useStyles = () => themedStyles((c) => ({ ...styles... }))();` — a trailing `()` erroneously invoked the returned Proxy object as a function. `themedStyles` from src/themeContext.tsx returns a Proxy that acts as a plain style object (not a factory). Attempting to call it raised `TypeError: (0 , _srcThemeContext.themedStyles)(...) is not a function`. Because the crash happened inside the top-level `useStyles()` call at component render, the entire CurrencyPicker screen showed the Expo error overlay every time the user tapped the Currency row on the More tab. REPRO: 1) Log in, 2) Vault tab -> tap 'Currency', 3) Observe Expo error overlay 'themedStyles(...) is not a function'. FIX APPLIED: removed the trailing `()` so the line reads `}));` — now `useStyles` returns the Proxy directly, matching the pattern used in every other file (wishlist.tsx, dealers.tsx, inventory.tsx, reports.tsx, etc.). After the fix, verified full happy path: EUR/JPY/INR selection propagates to Home/Inventory/Reports/Dealer/Tool detail money strings; JPY renders 0-decimal amounts (¥150, ¥1,286) confirming decimals config; revert to USD restores $150.00 exactly.
